Maison Clouet gathers estate-sale finds, market fragments, and back-room scent blends for people who prefer their objects with a past. this week Opaline, brass, linen, smoke, fig leaf. newest arrivals / synced from objets Eight pieces that did not want a white background. Each scent starts with a place note: cold stone at 8 a.m., tomato leaves under a basket, waxed church wood, rain on old paper. I blend in tiny batches so the scent shelf feels alive. If you reach the canal, you have gone too far, which is sometimes useful. Maison Clouet gathers estate-sale finds, market fragments, and back-room scent blends for people who prefer their objects with a past.
newest arrivals / synced from objets
Found at a house clearance near Apt, still wrapped in a pharmacy calendar from 1971.
A stack of six, hand-dyed in Arles, softened by years of lunch tables.
Heavy shade, green felt base, bought from a retired notaire's desk.
Blended in the back room after the market closes, green and slightly dusty.
